json:{"scope": "Ford Mustang Mach-E battery supply chain (cell, cathode, raw material, mine attribution)", "vehicle_program": "Mustang Mach-E (2021-2025 generations; this file 2023-2024 model years)", "period": "2023-2024", "status": "in_progress", "data_sources_policy": "PUBLIC SOURCES ONLY. Ford Integrated Sustainability Report, Ford 10-K,
IRA Section 30D Eligible Vehicles list (fueleconomy.gov), Ford press
releases, BlueOval SK / BlueOval Battery Park MI announcements, OEM
sustainability reports for upstream suppliers (CATL ESG, LGES SR, POSCO
Future M SR), peer-reviewed and industry news with named sources
(Reuters, Bloomberg free side, Automotive News, Electrek). NO Benchmark
Mineral Intelligence, BNEF, Wood Mackenzie, S&P Global Mobility, Adamas,
or any paywalled trade-data product. If a relationship is only verifiable
through those, it is filed under `gaps:` rather than `supply_relationships:`.
", "confidence_levels": "Same ladder as data/supply_chains/tesla.yaml. Repeated here for clarity:

confirmed_public_disclosure
    Named in Ford 10-K / Sustainability Report, IRA 30D eligibility list,
    the supplier's own SR/AR/IR, an SEC filing, or a contemporaneous
    joint press release. Either the relationship or a multi-year offtake
    is explicitly stated.

industry_reporting
    Named in Reuters / Automotive News / Electrek / Bloomberg (free
    side) / Nikkei with a NAMED human source (analyst, executive, or
    document leak). Single-source unattributed press articles are
    treated as inferred, not industry.

inferred
    Process-of-elimination from public facts (e.g., LGES Holland MI was
    Mach-E ER's named cell source pre-2024; Wroclaw historically
    supplied Mach-E EU exports; therefore EU-bound 2023 Mach-E ER cells
    likely originated at Wroclaw). Reasoning documented in `notes:`.

unknown
    Gap. Documented in `gaps:` with what would resolve.
", "field_definitions": "products[].id                    - Stable ID (FORD_<MODEL>_<TRIM>)
products[].pack_chemistry        - LFP | NMC | NCA | NCMA | mixed
products[].route_file            - Path to per-kWh route flow file the
                                    renderer pairs with this product
products[].pack_kWh              - Nameplate / usable pack capacity
                                    (verified against Ford spec sheet)
products[].cell_makers[].share_pct_estimate
                                 - "estimate" suffix where Ford did not
                                    disclose volume splits.

supply_relationships[].downstream / .upstream
                                 - Pair forming a single directed edge
supply_relationships[].material  - Material flowing on this edge
supply_relationships[].source_ids
                                 - References to sources/references.yaml
supply_relationships[].shared_with_tesla_rel
                                 - When the upstream relationship is
                                   identical to a Tesla-file edge, points
                                   to its REL_xxx for evidence rather than
                                   duplicating data. Ford-bilateral entries
                                   with Ford-specific evidence get their
                                   own FORD_REL_ ID.
supply_relationships[].quantity_estimate
                                 - Tonnage where public sources disclose
                                   (e.g. POSCO-Pilbara JV 43kt/yr LiOH).
", "cross_check_to_route_files": "Each product points to its per-kWh route file:
  FORD_MACHE_SR -> data/lfp/solid_state.yaml
  FORD_MACHE_ER -> data/nmc811/conventional.yaml
Companies named here SHOULD also appear in those files'
region_breakdown.companies lists (CATL Changshu, LGES Holland MI / Wroclaw,
POSCO Future M Gwangyang, Hunan Yuneng, BTR, Vale Sudbury, BHP Nickel West,
Tianqi Kwinana, Glencore KCC, etc.). Any mismatch is a flag for review.
", "ira_section_30d_note": "For the 2024 model year, IRA 30D credit eligibility is the cleanest public
disclosure event. Mach-E SR and ER credit statuses are tracked at
fueleconomy.gov; 2024 Mach-E lost full $7,500 credit due to FEOC content
rules tightening (CATL LFP cells are FEOC-affiliated). Ford's response,
starting late 2024 / 2025: domestic CATL-licensed LFP at Marshall MI
(BlueOval Battery Park; OUT OF SCOPE here, future scope file).
"}

json:[{"id": "FORD_GAP_001", "chain_step": "Mach-E SR LFP — second-source cell maker confirmation", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_SR"], "description": "Some 2022-era reporting (Reuters, Automotive News) suggested BYD as a
potential secondary LFP cell supplier for Mach-E SR. As of 2023-2024,
Ford's IRA 30D filing and Sustainability Report only name CATL.
Whether BYD is a current backup is not publicly verified. May or
may not be active in 2024 model year.
", "needs": "Ford_2024_disclosure | IRA_2025_supplier_list", "blocks_chains": ["Ford Mach-E SR -> BYD? -> ? (unverified secondary LFP path)"]}, {"id": "FORD_GAP_002", "chain_step": "BTR / Shanshan natural-graphite mine attribution for LGES NMC + CATL LFP", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_SR", "FORD_MACHE_ER"], "description": "Same opacity issue as tesla.yaml/GAP_002. Heilongjiang flake-graphite
mining is fragmented across small private operators aggregated through
trading houses before reaching BTR / Shanshan spheronization plants.
Mine-level attribution unavailable in BTR AR 2023; LGES SR 2023 and
CATL ESG 2023 stop at company-level supplier naming. Both Mach-E
trims affected (BTR is the dominant graphite anode supplier for both
CATL and LGES).
", "needs": "paid_database_access | Chinese_government_disclosure", "blocks_chains": ["Ford Mach-E SR -> CATL Changshu -> BTR -> Heilongjiang graphite mine", "Ford Mach-E ER -> LGES Holland/Wroclaw -> BTR -> Heilongjiang graphite mine"]}, {"id": "FORD_GAP_003", "chain_step": "POSCO Argentina Salar — specific block for Mach-E ER attribution", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_ER"], "description": "POSCO Holdings owns the Hombre Muerto Norte (Salta, AR) Li brine
project (operational from 2023-2024) and feeds Li2CO3 / LiOH into
POSCO Future M's CAM stream. Whether the Argentina-sourced Li
specifically lands in Mach-E ER NMC (vs. domestic Korean-customer
vehicles or other LGES OEMs) is not publicly attributed at the SKU
level. Likely shared, not Ford-exclusive.
", "needs": "POSCO_disclosure | LGES_disclosure", "blocks_chains": ["Ford Mach-E ER -> LGES -> POSCO Future M -> POSCO Argentina Salar (block-level unattributed)"]}, {"id": "FORD_GAP_004", "chain_step": "POSCO / LGES Indonesian HPAL Ni mine attribution", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_ER"], "description": "POSCO Future M's Ni precursor partly comes from the POSCO-Huayou
Indonesia HPAL JV (Halmahera Persada Lygend / Morowali). Specific
Sulawesi or Halmahera mine block -> matte -> NiSO4 attribution is
shared with CATL/Tesla GAP_001 in tesla.yaml. POSCO Future M SR 2023
stops at country level. Ford-specific allocation undisclosed.
", "needs": "paid_database_access | Indonesian_disclosure | POSCO_disclosure", "blocks_chains": ["Ford Mach-E ER -> LGES -> POSCO Future M -> Indonesian HPAL Ni mine (block unknown)"]}, {"id": "FORD_GAP_005", "chain_step": "DRC cobalt mine -> POSCO/L&F/EcoPro BM cathode for LGES Mach-E ER", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_ER"], "description": "Glencore (KCC + Mutanda DRC), CMOC (Tenke Fungurume DRC), and ERG
(Metalkol RTR DRC) all supply Co into the Korean cathode supply chain
via Chinese refining tolling (Huayou / GEM / Hanrui). Specific DRC
concession -> Korean cathode -> LGES Mach-E ER attribution is a
blended flow without per-OEM allocation. POSCO Future M SR 2023
and Glencore AR 2023 disclose at company level only. The Tesla-
Glencore bilateral PR (tesla.yaml/REL_028) is Tesla-specific and
does not extend to Ford.
", "needs": "Korean_FSS_filings | Glencore_per_customer_disclosure | OECD_DRC_traceability", "blocks_chains": ["Ford Mach-E ER -> LGES -> [POSCO/L&F/EcoPro BM] -> [Glencore/CMOC/ERG] -> DRC mine (specific concession)"]}, {"id": "FORD_GAP_006", "chain_step": "Mn supply chain for Mach-E ER NMC", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_ER"], "description": "Same as tesla.yaml/GAP_011. Mn is the lowest-attributed of NMC
inputs. Likely sources via Chinese MnSO4 plants drawing on South
Africa (Assmang, South32 Hotazel), Gabon (Eramet COMILOG), Australia
(South32 GEMCO until divestiture). Ford 2023 Sustainability Report
does not name Mn supplier; LGES SR 2023 mentions Mn supply diligence
generically.
", "needs": "paid_database_access | LGES_2024_SR", "blocks_chains": ["Ford Mach-E ER -> LGES -> POSCO/L&F/EcoPro BM -> MnSO4 -> ZA / Gabon / AU Mn mine"]}, {"id": "FORD_GAP_007", "chain_step": "Mexico build vs US-import — pack assembly attribution", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_SR", "FORD_MACHE_ER"], "description": "Mach-E final vehicle assembly is at Cuautitlán (Mexico). Pack-level
assembly point: cells/modules ship to Cuautitlán from CATL Changshu
(SR) and LGES Holland MI / Wroclaw (ER); pack-level integration
done at Cuautitlán per Ford 2023 Sustainability Report. Whether any
US-built Mach-E (e.g. modules pre-assembled in US then shipped)
exists is not separately disclosed. Affects USMCA / IRA value-add
calculation but does not change the cell-source attribution
established in FORD_REL_001-003.
", "needs": "Ford_disclosure | USMCA_origin_certificates", "blocks_chains": ["Pack-assembly geographic attribution (vs cell-source) — refinement only"]}, {"id": "FORD_GAP_008", "chain_step": "LGES Wroclaw vs Holland MI volume split for Mach-E ER", "affected_products": ["FORD_MACHE_ER"], "description": "Industry reporting estimates ~70% Holland MI / ~30% Wroclaw for
2023-2024 Mach-E ER cells, but neither LGES SR 2023 nor Ford 2023
Sustainability Report publish per-plant volume to Mach-E. FORD_REL_002
and FORD_REL_003 share estimates are industry_reporting only.
", "needs": "LGES_disclosure | Ford_disclosure", "blocks_chains": ["Ford Mach-E ER -> LGES (Holland vs Wroclaw share, geographic attribution)"]}]

FeSO4 is a TiO2 byproduct;
the Fe traces to ilmenite/sulfate-route Ti feedstock, not an iron

json:{"pack_kWh_check": {"status": "passed", "note": "FORD_MACHE_SR pack_kWh=70 (nominal), 72 usable: matches Ford 2024-MY
Mach-E SR RWD spec sheet (post-LFP shift). Pre-2023 SR was 68 kWh
NMC, intentionally excluded from this 2023-2024 file.
FORD_MACHE_ER pack_kWh=91 (nominal), 88 usable: matches Ford 2024-MY
Mach-E ER RWD/AWD spec sheet. GT trim shares ER pack architecture.
Both verified against ford.com Mach-E configuration pages and
EPA-certified ranges; source REF_FORD_SPECS_2024.
"}, "route_file_mapping_check": {"status": "passed", "note": "FORD_MACHE_SR -> data/lfp/solid_state.yaml (LFP solid-state route).
FORD_MACHE_ER -> data/nmc811/conventional.yaml (NMC811 conventional
hydroxide co-precipitation route).
Renderer should pair pack_kWh with the per-kWh flows in the pointed
file. No SR<->ER cross-contamination.
"}, "trim_separation_check": {"status": "passed", "note": "Zero overlap between SR (LFP) and ER (NMC) cells / cathode / cell-
maker relationships. SR draws CATL Changshu LFP cells with Hunan
Yuneng LFP CAM upstream; ER draws LGES Holland/Wroclaw NMC pouch
cells with POSCO Future M / L&F / EcoPro BM NMC CAM upstream. The
ONLY shared upstream node is BTR (graphite anode) since both LFP
and NMC cells use graphite — but BTR-CATL (FORD_REL_022) and
BTR-LGES (FORD_REL_033) are separate edges and cleanly partition
by trim.
"}, "share_pct_annotation_audit": {"status": "passed", "note": "Every share_estimate_pct is paired with a confidence level. Where
Ford or supplier publicly attested (CATL 100% to Mach-E SR, LGES
100% to Mach-E ER), share is exact. The 70/30 LGES Holland/Wroclaw
split is industry_reporting (FORD_REL_002 confirmed; FORD_REL_003
industry_reporting on share).
"}, "confidence_justification_audit": {"status": "passed", "note": "Every "confirmed_public_disclosure" entry cites either Ford 10-K /
Sustainability Report / IRA 30D filing OR the supplier's own SR/AR/IR
(with Ford or LGES/CATL named as customer) OR a contemporaneous
bilateral PR. Every "industry_reporting" entry cites Reuters /
Automotive News / Bloomberg with named source and concedes share-
level uncertainty. No "inferred" entries used in this file (Mach-E
cell-maker disclosure is unusually clean by IRA 30D mandate).
"}, "gap_overlap_audit": {"status": "passed", "note": "No `gaps:` entry duplicates a `supply_relationships:` entry. FORD_GAP_002
(BTR graphite mine) is the same structural gap as tesla.yaml/GAP_002 —
both files keep it because the affected products differ. FORD_GAP_005
(DRC Co allocation) is Ford-specific (Tesla closes its DRC chain via
the Tesla-specific Glencore PR REL_028, which does not extend to Ford).
"}, "end_to_end_traceability_check": {"status": "passed_partial", "fully_traceable_count": 5, "partially_traceable_count": 3, "notes": "5 chains trace Mach-E -> named mine end-to-end with public sources
only (2 for SR LFP, 3 for ER NMC). 3 chains close at country / TiO2-
plant / blended-DRC level and are documented in gaps:.
"}, "unverifiable_relationships": {"note": "Relationships removed during cross-check because the only source
would be Benchmark / paid trade data:
  - Specific BTR Heilongjiang graphite mine -> CATL/LGES anode -> moved to FORD_GAP_002.
  - Indonesian HPAL specific block -> POSCO Future M -> moved to FORD_GAP_004.
  - DRC Co specific concession allocation to LGES Mach-E flow -> moved to FORD_GAP_005.
  - Mn mine -> MnSO4 -> Mach-E ER -> moved to FORD_GAP_006.
Relationships included with low-confidence annotation rather than as gaps:
  - FORD_REL_003 (Ford -> LGES Wroclaw share for ER): industry_reporting on share.
  - FORD_REL_022 (CATL Changshu -> BTR graphite): industry_reporting on Ford-specific allocation.
  - FORD_REL_033 (LGES -> BTR graphite): industry_reporting.
  - FORD_REL_039 (POSCO Future M -> Glencore Co): industry_reporting on bilateral.
"}, "out_of_scope_note": "The following Ford-related supply chains are explicitly OUT OF SCOPE
for this file's 2023-2024 Mach-E focus:
  - F-150 Lightning (BlueOval SK Commerce GA, SK On NMC pouch)
  - E-Transit (LGES Holland MI, NMC, separate pack platform)
  - BlueOval Battery Park Marshall MI (CATL-licensed LFP, online 2026+)
  - BlueOval SK Stanton TN + Glendale KY (online 2025+)
These belong in a future Ford companion file covering 2025+ products
when their supply chains are operational and disclosed.
"}
